title: New York Chicken
description: This recipe for baked chicken calls for cream cheese and cream of mushroom soup.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat. Add garlic; cook until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Season with rosemary, salt, and black pepper. Add chicken; cook until completely browned, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a 9x13-inch baking dish, reserving drippings.
Stir cream of mushroom soup, cream cheese, white wine, and reserved drippings together in a bowl; pour over chicken.

Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 45 to 50 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
